candidates: When a PR removes existing logic, data structures, or fallback behaviour from a component, require an explanation—either in the PR description or as an inline code comment—of why the removal is safe or intentional. Do not accept silent deletions of non-trivial code without justification.

In Vue templates, keep static invariant CSS utility classes in the `class` attribute and place all conditional or page-dependent classes exclusively in a `:class` binding. Avoid embedding classes whose value depends on runtime state into the static `class` string, as this can create hard-to-spot conflicts between the static value and the dynamic override.
